description: NaAg(NO₂)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic F222 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in an octahedral geometry to two equivalent N and four equivalent O atoms. Both Na-N bond lengths are 2.47 Å. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.45 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.54 Å) and four longer (2.76 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Ag sites. In the first Ag site, Ag is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Ag-O bond lengths are 2.45 Å. In the second Ag site, Ag is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent N atoms. Both Ag-N bond lengths are 2.17 Å. There are two inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent O atoms. Both N-O bond lengths are 1.27 Å. In the second N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Ag and two equivalent O atoms. Both N-O bond lengths are 1.26 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one N atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ag, and one N atom.
